title: Martin Schreier
author_source: WU Wien, Professor of Marketing, Head of Department of Marketing and Institute for Marketing Management; Wien; academic
note: Teaches product and brand management at WU; research on customer-brand interaction and luxury brand customization (JMR 2020 'Customization in luxury brands: Can Valentino get personal?'), Journal of Retailing 2023 on retailing groundedness and brand perceptions; former Editor-in-Chief IJRM (2021-2024). English/German.
course_use: Natural in-house guest for a session on brand perception research and experimental brand measurement; on site Vienna; contact via institute page.

title: Gerhard Hrebicek
author_source: European Brand Institute (EBI), President; court-certified expert for brand valuation; Wien; practitioner
note: Leads the annual Österreichische Markenwert Studie (23rd edition, July 2026: Red Bull ~EUR 20.1bn at the top), Sustainable Brand Rating Austria and Global TOP 100 Brand Corporations; initiated ONR 16800 and chairs development of ISO 20671 (brand evaluation), the formal standard behind brand-strength audits. Berufstitel Professor 2025. German/English.
course_use: Strong fit for a guest lecture on brand evaluation standards (ISO 20671 vs ISO 10668) and the Austrian brand value ranking; on site Vienna; hosts Brand Global Summit and regular study presentations.

title: Günter Thumser
author_source: Österreichischer Markenartikelverband (MAV), Geschäftsführer; Wien; practitioner
note: Managing director of the Austrian branded goods association (106 member companies, founded 1925); public advocate for manufacturer brands vs. private labels (keynote at the 100-year gala, May 2025). German.
course_use: Panel or Q&A on brands vs. private labels in Austrian retail and the industry view on brand health; on site Vienna; contact via MAV.

title: Thomas (Tommy) Schwabl
author_source: Marketagent.com online reSEARCH GmbH, founder and managing director; Baden bei Wien; Österreich; practitioner
note: Runs Brand.Swipe (since 2017, >1,000 brands rated continuously) and Brand.Diamonds (2024 edition: >230,000 brand ratings of >1,200 brands on awareness, closeness, attractiveness, emotionality, fascination, attachment) – ready-made Austrian brand-health benchmarks for student audits; widely quoted in Austrian press. German.
course_use: Guest talk on designing brand-health tracking with online panels in Austria; published press charts usable as audit data; on site Vienna area or remote. Role confirmed via press results, company page does not name him.

title: Oliver Heiss
author_source: Brainds, Marken und Design GmbH (Vienna brand consultancy), Managing Partner; Wien; practitioner
note: Managing Partner of Brainds (founded 1997, ~20 staff; Business & Brand Strategy, Branding & Design, Employer Branding) since 2012, previously Senior Brand Consultant there; Forum Alpbach speaker profile. German/English.
course_use: Practitioner view on how an agency runs a brand diagnosis before a repositioning; on site Vienna. Role confirmed only via Alpbach profile snippet (page fetch failed); confirm before inviting.

title: Mike Fuisz
author_source: moodley strategy & design group (Vienna/Graz/Munich), co-founder; lecturer FH JOANNEUM; Österreich; practitioner
note: Co-founder of moodley (founded 1999, >100 staff), one of Austria's best-known brand-identity consultancies; focus on repositionings and brand refreshes (e.g. Martin Auer bakery rebrand in Graz). German/English.
course_use: Case-based guest lecture from brand audit to repositioning/rebrand; remote or on site Vienna. FH profile URL returned 404 at fetch time; role confirmed via search snippet.

title: Kurt Matzler
author_source: Universität Innsbruck, Professor of Strategic Management and Leadership; Österreich; academic
note: Co-author of brand trust and brand affect research, e.g. Matzler, Grabner-Kräuter & Bidmon (2006) 'The Value - Brand Trust - Brand Loyalty Chain' and Matzler et al. (2006) 'Individual determinants of brand affect' (Journal of Product & Brand Management) – constructs for consumer-side audit questionnaires; among the most-cited researchers in his field. German/English.
course_use: Reading author or remote guest on brand trust/loyalty measurement; on site possible.

title: Sonja Grabner-Kräuter
author_source: Alpen-Adria-Universität Klagenfurt, Associate Professor of Marketing and International Management; Österreich; academic
note: Research on consumer trust, online consumer behaviour and CSR perceptions; co-author of the brand trust–loyalty chain paper with Matzler; publications in Journal of Product & Brand Management and Journal of Advertising. German/English.
course_use: Remote session on measuring brand trust and CSR perceptions within a brand audit.

title: Thomas Foscht
author_source: Universität Graz, Head of Department of Marketing, Dean School of Business, Economics and Social Sciences; President Marketing Club Graz; Österreich; academic
note: Expert in buyer behaviour, retail and service marketing (co-author of the German textbook 'Käuferverhalten'); research on private labels in consumers' consideration sets – relevant for competitive brand audits in retail. German/English.
course_use: Remote or on site guest on consumer-behaviour foundations of brand audits; link to the Styrian marketing club network.

title: Bettina Schuckert
author_source: Gewista, Head of Marketing; President Effie Austria (IAA Austrian Chapter); Wien; practitioner
note: Leads Effie Austria, the national award for demonstrably effective campaigns (2026 shortlist: 79 campaigns; gala 12 Nov 2026, Sofiensäle Wien) – source of Austrian cases linking brand KPIs to business results. German.
course_use: Guest on effectiveness evidence and how brand metrics are presented in Effie cases; on site Vienna. Role confirmed via press search results, not named on the fetched IAA page.

title: Kevin Lane Keller
author_source: Tuck School of Business, Dartmouth, E. B. Osborn Professor of Marketing; Global; academic
note: Author of 'Strategic Brand Management' (with Swaminathan), which formalised the brand audit (brand inventory + brand exploratory) and the CBBE pyramid; HBR 'The Brand Report Card' (2000); his MBA course uses a team brand-audit project. English.
course_use: Core reading author; use recorded lectures/interviews; a course brand audit assignment can mirror his design. Live guest unlikely.

title: Jean-Noël Kapferer
author_source: HEC Paris, Emeritus Professor of Marketing; Global; academic
note: Brand Identity Prism (six facets) and 'The New Strategic Brand Management' – standard frame for the identity side of a brand audit; luxury brand management. English/French.
course_use: Reading author; recorded talks; remote keynote request possible.

title: David Aaker
author_source: Prophet, Vice Chairman; Professor Emeritus UC Berkeley Haas; Global; academic/practitioner
note: 'Managing Brand Equity' (1991, brand equity dimensions and measures), 'Building Strong Brands' (brand identity model); blog and short videos on brand strategy. English.
course_use: Reading author; use his blog/videos; live guest unlikely.

title: Jenni Romaniuk
author_source: Ehrenberg-Bass Institute, University of South Australia, Research Professor and International Associate Director; Global; academic
note: 'Better Brand Health' (OUP) – evidence-based design of brand health tracking (mental availability, category entry points); 'Building Distinctive Brand Assets' (2018) – distinctive asset audit method; past executive editor Journal of Advertising Research. English.
course_use: Remote guest or podcast episode (Uncensored CMO ep. 74) as pre-class material for the consumer-research part of a brand audit.

title: Mark Ritson
author_source: Mini MBA in Marketing / Brand Management, founder and lead instructor; Marketing Week columnist; Global; communicator
note: Mini MBA in Brand Management covers brand diagnosis, positioning, codes, architecture, budgeting and brand tracking; prolific columnist and speaker on brand health research. English.
course_use: Columns/videos as debate input; live guest costly; students can take the paid Mini MBA.

title: Les Binet
author_source: adam&eveDDB, Head of Effectiveness; IPA effectiveness author; Global; practitioner
note: Co-author with Peter Field of 'The Long and the Short of It' (2013) and 'Marketing in the Era of Accountability', based on the IPA Effectiveness Databank – which brand metrics predict long-term growth. English.
course_use: Recorded talks/podcasts; remote Q&A possible. Article fetched; current agency role from general knowledge, not on the fetched page.

title: Peter Field
author_source: Independent marketing effectiveness consultant; IPA effectiveness author; Global; practitioner
note: Co-author of the IPA effectiveness studies; brand-building vs. activation, emotional vs. rational advertising, share of voice and brand metrics. English.
course_use: Recorded talks; remote session on linking audit metrics to effectiveness.

title: David Haigh
author_source: Brand Finance, founder and Chairman (CEO in some bios); Global; practitioner
note: Former Director of Brand Valuation at Interbrand, founded Brand Finance 1996; represented BSI on the ISO 10668 (brand valuation) and ISO 20671 (brand evaluation) working parties; Global Soft Power Index. English.
course_use: Remote guest on financial brand valuation as one module of a brand audit; Brand Finance webinars.

title: Franz-Rudolf Esch
author_source: EBS Business School, Chair of Brand Management, Director Institut für Marken- und Kommunikationsforschung; founder ESCH. The Brand Consultants; Global (DE); academic/practitioner
note: Author of 'Strategie und Technik der Markenführung', 'Identität: Das Rückgrat starker Marken', 'Marke 4.0'; leading German-language reference on brand controlling and brand checks. German.
course_use: German-language reading author; remote guest; consultancy cases.

title: Christoph Burmann
author_source: Universität Bremen, markstones Institute of Marketing, Branding & Technology, Professor; Global (DE); academic
note: Lead author of 'Identitätsbasierte Markenführung' (5th ed. 2024, Springer Gabler) incl. brand controlling; working papers on identity-based brand valuation (No. 76, 2024) and brand budgeting. German/English.
course_use: Reading author for the internal (identity) side of an audit; remote guest possible.

title: Carsten Baumgarth
author_source: HWR Berlin, Professor of Marketing esp. Brand Management; runs B*lab; Baumgarth & Baumgarth Brandconsulting; Global (DE); academic/practitioner
note: Co-author of 'Markenaudit für Kulturinstitutionen' (Springer) – one of few books presenting a complete brand audit tool; 'Markentools I: Brand Canvas' (B*canvas integrated into a Markenaudit); B2B branding, brand orientation; textbook 'Markenpolitik'. German/English.
course_use: Very good fit: remote guest lecture walking through a structured Markenaudit tool; has given guest talks at other universities (e.g. Bremen).

title: Jon Evans
author_source: Uncensored CMO podcast, host (formerly CMO/CCO System1); Global; communicator
note: 200+ episodes, >3m downloads; guests include Romaniuk, Binet, Field, Ritson on brand health and effectiveness; running Uncensored CMO full time with live events from 2026. English.
course_use: Assign episodes as pre-class listening; remote guest possible.

title: Österreichischer Markenartikelverband (MAV)
author_source: Organiser: MAV, association of branded goods manufacturers (106 members); type: industry association/events; Wien
note: Represents Austrian brand manufacturers; annual joint brand campaign (30th edition 2026); 100-year gala 2025; studies on the economic value of brands.
course_use: Corporate membership only; students can use studies/press material and invite MAV for panels. Own website (markenartikel.at) not reachable at check time.

title: Marketing Club Österreich (MCÖ) & Marketing Club Rookies
author_source: Organiser: MCÖ (largest marketing club in AT, ~1,000 members; President Andreas Ladich); type: professional network/events; Wien
note: 20-45 events per year (talks, workshops, MARKETING X conference, VAMP Award, Staatspreis Marketing, Marketing Leader); 'Marketing Club Rookies' is the youth club with mentoring and events.
course_use: Students can attend Rookies events; trial membership ('Jetzt schnuppern'); fees on separate page.

title: DMVÖ – Dialog Marketing Verband Österreich & Marketing Natives
author_source: Organiser: DMVÖ; Marketing Natives = its young-professional association; type: association/events; Wien
note: Expert groups (B2B, data compliance, automation/CX, social influence); Marketing Natives Signature Events, e.g. May 2026 'Past Forward' on the future of brands (IKEA Austria, LUX FUX). Youth site marketingnatives.at.
course_use: Students can attend Marketing Natives events and network with young brand managers; low barrier.

title: Effie Awards Austria (IAA Austrian Chapter)
author_source: Organiser: IAA Austria; type: award/gala/case archive; Wien
note: Award for demonstrably effective campaigns; 2026 shortlist 79 campaigns in 20 categories; gala 12 Nov 2026 in the Sofiensäle; online archive of Effie entries – Austrian cases showing brand KPIs; IAA Young Professionals network.
course_use: Use the Effie archive for audit case material; gala tickets via oeticket; IAA Young Professionals for students.

title: European Brand Institute – Markenwert Studie, Brand Global Summit & Vienna Brand Gala
author_source: Organiser: European Brand Institute (with UNIDO, State of Lower Austria, Deloitte); type: study + conference; Wien
note: Annual Austrian brand value study (23rd edition, July 2026), Sustainable Brand Rating; 22nd Brand Global Summit 20-21 Oct 2026 ('The Power of Brands – Leading in a new economic reality'); magazine brandannual.
course_use: Study results usable as audit benchmarks; summit is industry-priced, ask EBI for student/academic access.

title: Brand Finance – Austria 25 ranking, Brandirectory & Global Soft Power Summit
author_source: Organiser: Brand Finance (London); type: rankings/events/webinars; Global (with Austrian ranking)
note: Annual Austria 25 brand value ranking (2025: EUR 40bn; 2026: EUR 46.8bn, Red Bull first); Brandirectory pages for single Austrian brands; Brand Strength Index methodology.
course_use: Free online rankings and brand pages for student audits; some events/webinars free.

title: Marketing Accountability Standards Board (MASB)
author_source: Organiser: MASB (est. 2007); type: standards board/summits; Global (US)
note: Brand Investment & Valuation (BIV) project towards generally accepted brand measurement standards; 'The Financial Value of Brands Imperative' (2021); references ISO 20671.
course_use: Free public papers for readings on linking brand metrics to financial value; summits for members.

title: Ehrenberg-Bass Institute Corporate Sponsorship Programme
author_source: Organiser: Ehrenberg-Bass Institute, University of South Australia; type: corporate research consortium; Global
note: 100+ sponsoring firms (e.g. PepsiCo, Mars, Mondelez, Diageo) fund research on brand health, mental availability, distinctive assets; sponsors receive seminars and full research library (Baseline tier reportedly ~USD 70k p.a.).
course_use: Not for students directly; free articles/podcasts on marketingscience.info usable in class.

title: EMAC – European Marketing Academy Annual Conference
author_source: Organiser: EMAC (since 1975); type: academic conference; Global/Europe
note: Main European marketing research conference with branding tracks; 2026 in Bath (2-5 June); 2027 announced for LUISS Rome, 25-28 May 2027 (secondary source).
course_use: For research-oriented Master/PhD students; fees approx. EUR 650-700.

title: Mini MBA in Brand Management (Mark Ritson) – alumni community
author_source: Organiser: Mini MBA / Marketing Week; type: online course + alumni network; Global
note: 12-week on-demand course covering brand diagnosis, positioning, codes, architecture, budgeting and tracking; large alumni base on LinkedIn.
course_use: Paid (approx. GBP 1,500-2,000); free on-demand open-day webinars.

title: Uncensored CMO (podcast and live events)
author_source: Organiser: Jon Evans; type: podcast/events; Global (London)
note: Episodes with Jenni Romaniuk ('Better Brand Health'), Binet, Field and other brand-measurement experts; >200 episodes; live events from 2026.
course_use: Free podcast; assign episodes as pre-class listening.
